listings.title: FLO carbon wheelset (FLO 60 front + likely 90 rear), 11-speed, rim brake, aluminium brake track
listings.verdict: Wheel upgrade for the Lévis P2, not a bike. FLO rims are carbon fairings over an aluminium brake track, so they pass the rim-brake rule. Asking $350, negotiable; worth ~$400-500 used. Net ~$250-275 after selling the P2's stock Shimano wheels.
notes: Ad: bought 2016 for $800 + tax, used only for triathlon races, negotiable. Posted 1 week ago. Photo shows a FLO 60 front with Conti GP4000 tyres; a thin light band at the rim edge matches the alloy brake track.
11-speed freehub: takes the P2's 10-speed cassette with a 1.85 mm spacer.
Check: cracks or lifting where the carbon fairing meets the alloy rim, hub bearings, brake-track wear, and which rear depth it is.
Kijiji messaging needs Ryan's Kijiji login: send it himself if the session can't.
2026-09-29: Ryan: hold the wheels message until the Lévis P2 closes at a good price. Draft kept, not approved.

draft.purpose: Open on the FLO wheels at $300
draft.text: Bonjour! Les roues FLO sont toujours disponibles? C'est quelle profondeur à l'arrière (60 ou 90)? Aucune fissure sur le carénage carbone et les roulements tournent bien? Je pourrais offrir 300$ cash, sous réserve de les voir. Je suis à Laval.

listings.title: Opus Magnificat TT frameset (7005 alloy, carbon stays/fork), 54 TT / 48 ST
listings.verdict: Frameset, 18 weeks listed. Built up: + wheels ~$250, 105 group ~$350, basebar/aerobars ~$150, saddle $60, build $150 = all-in ~$1,250. Worth ~$700 complete (weak-resale alloy TT). Not a steal even with parts.

listings.title: Devinci Leo T2 carbon frameset M (brakes/levers/aerobars incl.)
listings.verdict: Needs wheels, crank, derailleurs, shifters, saddle (~$650-800 + build $150) plus gas $50: all-in ~$1,900 for a bike worth ~$1,100 (weak Devinci resale). Pass.

listings.title: Devinci Leo T2 carbon 54, Ultegra, Zipp 404 (carbon clincher)
listings.verdict: Not a good deal at $1,800: worth ~$1,400 (Leo T2 + Ultegra ~$800-900, Zipp 404 ~$600-700 resale); all-in = close + ~$270 (gas $20, alloy wheelset $250 for rim-brake rule; tune-up done). Good deal only at ~$1,100 or less. Listed 9 hours ago.
notes: Ad: 54 cm, Shimano Ultegra (speed not stated), Zipp 404 with new GP5000, full carbon, tune-up at start of season, aero bottle and cages included. Listed 9 h ago at $1,800.
Model: Devinci Leo T2 (Devinci TT, rim brakes). Year and stack/reach unknown: geometry not found this run; ask stack or seller height before any offer.

Photo: Zipp 404 rims are dark all the way to the edge, so carbon brake track (Firecrest-era clincher). Carbon rims + rim brakes break the hard rule: ride it on an alloy wheelset (~$250) and keep or sell the Zipps (~$600-700).

Value evidence: tracked Leo T2s at $1,050 (Ottawa, older) and $1,950 (Boucherville, SRAM Force, valued ~$1,100); Devinci resale is weak. Zipp 404 clincher pair ~$600-700 used (estimate, not checked on Pinkbike).
